extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, prospective applicants, stakeholders, and the public interested in CDMRP funding programs
extracted.subtask_description: A landing/overview page describing the Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP), listing funded research programs, links to funding and review resources, and high-level mission/history. It serves as an entry point for applicants and stakeholders to find program- and funding-specific information.
